parsed.rationale: The second participating record (`Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, package `Wallpaper`) carries `is_sample_app: true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates any action signal. The near-identical `DebugMetricsProvider` in the sample app is a deliberate demonstration fixture mirroring the production type in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift`; lifting it into a shared PAT would couple production `DebugPanel` semantics to sample-app demonstration code. The only structural difference (`metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?`) is a minor existential-syntax variant consistent with independent evolution of a copy, not evidence that the sample-app record is a removable prototype.
